property_summary: For any non-empty _tos, C.transfer either reverts or returns true, and when it returns it does not change address(c).balance.
For any non-empty _tos, if C.transfer does not revert then it returns true.

For any non-empty _tos array, transfer(...) either reverts (if any sub-call fails) or returns true; when it returns, it must return true and make an external call for each _tos entry (observable by successful overall return).
For any non-empty _tos array, calling transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false).

If _tos is non-empty, transfer either reverts or returns true; when it returns true it does not change address(this).balance (since C.transfer does external calls but does not transfer Ether to the caller).

For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, transfer either reverts or returns true; when it returns true, it must have performed all internal loop iterations (i.e., number of successful external sub-calls equals _tos.length) as evidenced by returning true without revert.
If _tos is empty, transfer reverts; otherwise the call either reverts or returns true.
